card.line: Arabia is a large, dry region of deserts and tribes southeast of Israel, known for trade and caravans, and where Paul went after meeting Jesus.

moments.title: Arabian kings bring gold
moments.text: Arabian kings and governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon. This was part of the great wealth that came to him each year.

moments.title: A message against Arabia
moments.text: Isaiah spoke a burden against Arabia. Caravans of Dedanites had to lodge in its thickets, and the glory of Kedar would be gone within a year.

moments.title: Arabia's kings drink the cup
moments.text: Jeremiah named the kings of Arabia among those who must drink the cup of the LORD's judgment, because of the sword He would send.

moments.title: Arabia trades with Tyre
moments.text: Arabia and the princes of Kedar were customers of Tyre. They traded in lambs, rams, and goats.

moments.title: Paul goes into Arabia
moments.text: After God revealed His Son to him, Paul did not go to the apostles in Jerusalem. He went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.
